content.short: Bittensor is a decentralized machine learning network that incentivizes the production of artificial intelligence.
content.description: Bittensor is an open-source protocol that powers a decentralized, blockchain-based machine learning network. It enables participants to contribute computational power and machine learning models to a global pool of intelligence, where they are rewarded in TAO tokens based on the value and accuracy of their contributions. Unlike centralized AI models, Bittensor creates a competitive and collaborative marketplace for intelligence that is permissionless and transparent. This 'Internet of Artificial Intelligence' allows developers to access sophisticated AI capabilities through a decentralized network of specialized subnets. By democratizing the development and ownership of AI, Bittensor aims to create a more equitable and powerful future for artificial intelligence.
content.meta: Bittensor is a decentralized machine learning protocol that creates an incentive-driven marketplace for global artificial intelligence and intelligence sharing.
